adjudication.rationale: In `lib/topic_retriever.rb`, the only added spec (`spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb`) asserts whether `retrieve` calls `perform_retrieve` by stubbing `retrieved_recently?` and setting expectations on `perform_retrieve`, but it never allows `perform_retrieve` to run its internal logic. No other spec in the diff exercises `perform_retrieve`/`fetch_http`: the early bail-out `return if TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: @embed_url).exists?`, the `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` branch that runs `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})`, and `fetch_http`’s user lookup + `TopicEmbed.import_remote` call are all untested in the diff. This is a concrete test-coverage gap for nontrivial new behavior, not a proven functional defect.
